description:
## Why

Tie `.6`, `.6b`, `.7`, `.8`, `.9` together. `Interactive.state.transcript :: [entry]` becomes `%Transcript{}`. `apply_partial` / `finalize_assistant` collapse into `Transcript.update_block` / `Transcript.finalize`. The `block_id` plumbing from `.6` lands in `AssistantMessage` content via `.9`. Width/theme changes cascade from `Transcript.resize` / `retheme` down through nested per-message state.

## Depends on

- `opi-4dx.6` (per-block delta events with `block_id`)
- `opi-4dx.7` (`Markdown.Render`)
- `opi-4dx.8` (`Transcript` module)
- `opi-4dx.9` (AssistantMessage recursion)

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:551, 1202` — `MessageUpdate` handle/event paths; replace with handlers for `MessageBlockStart`/`Delta`/`End`.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1596-1600` — `update_transcript` dispatch on event struct; rewrite for new event shape.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1685-1740` — `apply_partial` / `finalize_assistant`. Replace with `Transcript.update_block` / `Transcript.finalize_message`.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1746-1795` — `find_last_assistant`, `extract_content_blocks`, `extract_stop_reason`, `has_tool_calls?` — most of these go away once the agent ships block-keyed events.
- Width/resize handler — search `:resize` / width updates.

## Shape

- `Interactive.state.transcript` is a `%Transcript{}`.
- `MessageStart` opens a new transcript entry (an empty AssistantMessage).
- `MessageBlockStart` / `MessageBlockDelta` / `MessageBlockEnd` from `.6` route to `Transcript.update_block(t, msg_id, block_id, kind, snapshot)`. Pull-tick coalescing keeps "latest snapshot per `block_id`"; intermediate deltas drop harmlessly.
- `MessageEnd` finalizes the message (drops streaming renderer, copies cached output into `rendered`).
- The render path returns iolist; `Interactive` hands that to the terminal write path (no flat `[String.t()]` allocation on the hot path).
- Width change: `Transcript.resize(t, theme, width)`.

## Acceptance

- A long conversation (≥ 10 finalized messages) with one streaming message: per-tick `transcript.render` cost is flat in finalized message count.
- No `List.replace_at` calls on the streaming hot path.
- All existing TUI integration tests pass (or are migrated cleanly to the new event shape).
- `key.latency` p50 stays sub-millisecond at mailbox=0.
- `MessageUpdate` removed from the event handlers; everything routes through the per-block events.

## Tests

- Existing `interactive_test.exs` and `interactive_integration_test.exs` continue to pass after migration.
- New: streaming a long response while holding a multi-message history; assert `markdown.render` telemetry fires only on the streaming message's pending tail and not on finalized history.
- New: out-of-order `MessageBlockDelta` events for the same message but different `block_id`s render correctly.
